name: agy-acp
description: Multi-account Antigravity CLI (agy acp) model provider plugin for Magpie and OpenCode

summary.en: Multi-account Antigravity CLI provider over ACP (agy acp): sign in to multiple isolated Google accounts or adopt your local agy login, with native HTTP MCP tool bridging, warm session reuse, session/resume, per-step cache token accounting, and quota-aware routing. Shares each Google account's Antigravity quota pool with antigravity and agy-cli.
summary.zh: 基于本地 agy CLI（agy acp）的多账号 Antigravity 模型插件：支持隔离登录多个 Google 账号或复用本机 agy 登录，内置原生 HTTP MCP 工具桥接、热会话复用与 session/resume 续接、逐 step 缓存/Token 精确结算及配额自动切号。同一 Google 账号与 antigravity、agy-cli 共用同一额度池。
